column1: # What this library measures, paired against what it must not break: five surfaces by five kinds
# of coverage. Every cell says something. A blank cell is refused by the stem that reads this
# file, because an empty cell claims nothing and is exactly the ambiguity this file removes.
# The fifth column is a widening, declared here rather than absorbed silently. The requirement
# behind this file names four kinds -- negative, property, fuzz and concurrency -- and this file
# carries a fifth, for lifetime and sanitizer evidence. The evidence for widening it is this
# project's own: a reference that outlived what it referred to passed the whole local suite under
# one toolchain and failed under another, and a reference outliving its referent is a failure
# mode none of the four named kinds detects by construction. A widening absorbed silently is the
# same defect as a narrowing absorbed silently.
# A cell opens with one of three words.
#   tests:    the cell is carried by something that fails the build when it breaks.
#   advisory: the only thing carrying the cell is a job that cannot fail the build. Such a cell
#             says so outright, because a reference that cannot fail is closer to a reason than
#             to a test.
#   reason:   nothing measures the cell, and the cell says specifically why. "Not applicable" is
#             not a reason, and neither is "none".
# Any word beginning with tests/ or .github/ is a reference: a repository-relative path with an
# optional :line. Every one is resolved against the tree, and a reference under tests/unit or
# tests/property must also be registered by name in a listfile, because a stem missing from a
# foreach list is a file that silently never runs. References under tests/fuzz, tests/compile and
# tests/golden are registered by glob or read as data, and are resolved by existence alone.
# What the gate checks: that every cell is present, that its marker is one of the three, and that
# every reference it cites resolves and runs. What the gate does not check: whether a reason is a
# good reason. Review carries that, and saying so here is what keeps this file from being read as
# a stronger claim than it is.
# The first row names the columns; the five rows after it are the surfaces.

The job carrying both the campaign and the replay of every committed input cannot fail the build, so this is a notice rather than a gate
column5: advisory: .github/workflows/sanitizers.yml tests/unit/native_session_test.cpp:148 -- no case aims two threads at a conversion. The shared-handle load case renders each thread's own property through the conversion path incidentally, and a thread-sanitized run of the whole suite reported nothing over it; the job that carries that sweep cannot fail the build. The one thing the conversion path shares between threads is a lazily initialized read-only C locale handle, so a case written for this cell would assert the language's own initialization rule rather than a decision of this project
column6: advisory: .github/workflows/sanitizers.yml -- the address and undefined-behavior leg builds and runs the whole suite under instrumentation, so this surface is swept rather than asserted. The leg cannot fail the build: a run whose sanitizer leg fails still reports success, which is how a live use-after-scope survived three consecutive pushes behind a green badge

column4: reason: structurally unreachable today. Neither harness installs an auxiliary-document parser -- tests/fuzz/evaluator_fuzz.cpp and tests/fuzz/structural_fuzz.cpp each drive a bare scope -- so the document load resolves nothing and no fuzzed input reaches the reader at all. Three axes in tests/golden/matrix/limit_axes.tsv are unreached for the same reason. A harness that installs a reader is writable; until one exists a seed here could not fire, and a seed that cannot fire is worse than this reason

column5: reason: no case drives two concurrent loads against a ceiling. The counters a ceiling charges are per load by construction, and a case exhausting one load while a second runs through the same shared configuration would pin exactly the cross-load bleed that splitting them closed. It is writable and nobody has written it, so this is outstanding work and the most valuable of the empty cells in this column

Both run in the ordinary suite. The instrumented leg beside them sweeps the surface but cannot fail the build
